correctness.rationale: Uniform posterior on the set of 90 labeled deck words consistent with yes/no history. The unnormalized Bellman recursion F(B,t)=max_g (|H_g|+F(H_g,t+1)+F(N_g,t+1)) is exact. Componentwise lower/upper score-polynomial recursions take min/max over Bellman-optimal actions and independently optimal continuations. Equality of every component at root proves all deterministic optimal policies have the same polynomial; mixtures preserve it. Independently implemented a tuple-of-word-index recursion (not the source bit-mask representation), visited 11867 states, returned F=271 and identical coefficient vectors (0,0,33,30,21,5,1). Mean 271/90 and variance 7469/8100 follow; finite exhaustive enumeration is complete for the specified deck, not all compositions.

evidence: Published broad expected-value bounds and simple heuristics do not determine an exact law at six cards or invariance of the entire optimal-policy distribution.
The 2026 Luo work proves expectation inequalities over compositions, not distributional uniqueness in its accessible abstract.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General cardinality and expectation results are not logical implications of equality of all score-polynomial coefficients; explicit dynamic-program extrema are needed.
